**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Continental/analytic-adjacent philosophy of language, philosophy of mind, aesthetics and philosophy of art; frequently organized around thematic special issues edited by guest editors, plus occasional 'symposium' sections on a single thinker or text.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** philosophy of language, philosophy of mind, aesthetics / philosophy of art, history of philosophy (e.g. Leibniz, Spinoza, Wittgenstein symposia), philosophy of cognition/cognitive science (non-representational accounts of social cognition, de-humanizing cognition/AI/agency), visual/performing/media arts theory
